en.title: inject() Isn't a Service Locator: Understanding the Injection Context
en.subtitle: inject() reads the injector Angular sets for a moment. In a method, a callback or after an await, there's none.

ar-EG.title: ليه inject() بيرمي NG0203؟ فهم الـ injection context
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ inject() بيقرا الـ injector اللي Angular بيحطه للحظة. وفي method أو callback أو بعد await، مفيش injector.

sources.title: NG0203: inject() must be called from an injection context — Angular
